For a geometric random variable X with success probability p, which formula gives P(X>t)? Choices: A) p^t | B) (1-p)^t | C) (1-p)^(t-1)·p | D) 1-(1-p)^t Answer with the letter only.
Hints: X>t means the first t trials are all failures
Solution: The first $t$ trials must all fail, so $P(X>t)=(1-p)^t$. The answer is B.
